club.description: Farnworth United reflects the textile and engineering traditions of Farnworth and the wider Bolton area. Its identity centres on local loyalty, working heritage and the close-knit communities that have shaped football culture in this part of Greater Manchester.

descriptions.de: Farnworth United spiegelt die Textil- und Maschinenbautraditionen von Farnworth und der weiteren Region Bolton wider. Lokale Verbundenheit, das Erbe der Arbeiter und enge Gemeinschaften prägen die Fußballkultur dieser Gegend von Greater Manchester.
descriptions.es: Farnworth United refleja las tradiciones textiles y de ingeniería de Farnworth y del área de Bolton. El arraigo local, el legado obrero y las comunidades unidas definen la cultura futbolística de esta zona del Gran Mánchester.
descriptions.fr: Farnworth United reflète les traditions textiles et mécaniques de Farnworth et de la région de Bolton. L'attachement local, l'héritage ouvrier et la cohésion des communautés façonnent la culture footballistique de cette partie du Grand Manchester.
descriptions.it: Farnworth United riflette le tradizioni tessili e meccaniche di Farnworth e dell'area di Bolton. Radicamento locale, eredità operaia e comunità coese definiscono la cultura calcistica di questa zona della Greater Manchester.
descriptions.en: Farnworth United reflects the textile and engineering traditions of Farnworth and the wider Bolton area. Its identity centres on local loyalty, working heritage and the close-knit communities that have shaped football culture in this part of Greater Manchester.
